facts.fact: Queen Elizabeth Park is 125 metres above sea level, the highest point in Vancouver, with views towards the city and North Shore mountains.
facts.location: Overview: At 125 m above sea level, it’s the highest point in Vancouver.

facts.fact: The park contains a landscaped quarry garden, arboretum, Henry Moore sculpture and Bloedel Conservatory.
facts.location: Overview paragraph listing garden, arboretum, sculptures and conservatory.
